comments.author: Rashid
comments.body:
A slight reduction to tariffs(Buying & Selling) with that nation's ports (Territory and Allied).
Normal: 0%
Amity: -1%
Goodwill: -2%
Trust: -3%
Affection: -4%
Sworn Allies: -5%

Enmity towards a nation has a reverse effect of increasing tariffs by the same rate.

comments.author: Carla
comments.body:
sure, no problem. simply counting ports under control of nations doesn't give an accurate order of stronger to weaker. KOEI does not think players need to know exactly how it is determined (game of discovery and all that).

It will give you a rough idea, but it will not show you the exact order.

At one time France had control of more ports than any other country, and it wasn't even close. At no time was France the strongest country in the game according to defection order.

That's about as much info as I or anyone can give on it.

To know the order, you have to get all 6 starter nations to run together and see who can defect and who can't. the strongest nation will be able to defect to all the others, 2nd strongest all but one, etc. That's the only reliable way to work it out that I know of.
